before.coordinate_region_definition: r5 exact: world-space (z - body_world_bbox_min_z) / body_world_bbox_height >= 0.76 is head; >= 0.65 is neck
before.weight_definition: v5 selector (reported independently): every duplicate vertex has summed head+neck skin weight >= 0.50
before.selection_definition: v6: r5 geometric head AND UV-discontinuous AND loop-normal divergence > 1.0 degrees; no skin-weight predicate
